name: devkit
description: Command-gated skill packs, agents, and hooks for AI-assisted development: subagent-driven development, LangChain agents, LangGraph workflows, a documentation methodology, UI/UX design driven by the bundled Dolle-MCP server, web performance (Core Web Vitals), UI design craft (fundamentals + design systems: tokens, theming, component library), native/desktop GUI design (Qt, GTK, WinUI — platform HIG, windows, menus, HiDPI, accessibility), prompt enhancement (clarify with AskUserQuestion, then sharpen), app prompt engineering (interview an app idea into a build-ready spec), and shipping to platforms — Docker containerization, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (CI/CD & IaC). Packs live in packs/ and are exposed on demand via loader commands so they never bloat startup context.
